Team —

- ARR: $450k first 12 months; committed reserved capacity for 2x large GPU nodes during business hours.

- Go-live target: pilot internal staff Jan 30 — full production for cluster A on Feb 21.

Key artifacts attached: Clarion_Health_Signed_SOW.pdf, Clarion-term-sheet.xlsx, network_requirements.xlsx. DocuSign completes the SOW; link in related_links.

- We should plan for KV cache warming and a limited rollout to 10 clinicians for the pilot.
- They asked for an initial quantization profile recommendation for throughput; Karthik, please advise if we need any special kernel tuning for their LLM variant.

Ops / commercial items:
- PO promised by 1/17 — procurement contact is Rajesh (cc'd on external).
- Pricing: they accepted the reserved capacity package with a 6% annual billing grace; finance confirmed.

Recommended owners:
- Primary CS lead: Tessa Morgan (recommended) — owns kickoff, success plan, and weekly playbook.
- Technical: Karthik Iyer — architecture + production tuning during pilot.
- Deal owner / executive sponsor: Mateo Alvarez (I'll stay engaged through pilot).

Immediate asks:
1) Tessa — can you take primary and propose a 30/60/90 success plan and kickoff date windows by EOD tomorrow?
2) Karthik — flag any blockers on the network/VPC requirements and estimate a 1st-pass quantization approach by Wednesday.
3) CS ops — we will need a pre-kickoff checklist (accounts, API keys, sample data exchange method).

Thanks — Mateo

Looping in a few technical notes after reviewing the SOW and the network sheet: 

- Network/VPC: their list looks standard — we'll need their peering CIDR & a contact for firewall rules. If they insist on private on-prem routing we may need an architecture call; otherwise VPC peering + NAT for outbound is fine.
- Quantization/tuning: recommend starting with 4-bit PTQ for the initial pilot to balance latency and accuracy; we should plan a performance bench on their typical 512-token prompts. I can run that in our staging environment this week.
- Cache strategy: for clinician note generation, prefix-KV caching will help with repeated context (patient header templates). Plan a cache TTL of ~24 hours for the pilot and monitor token-hit rate.
- Rollout phasing suggestion: Pilot (10 users) → Cluster A (100 users) → Clusters B/C (staged over 6 weeks).

Blockers: need the VPC peering details, BAA requirement (if required, we will pause key issuance until signed), and a PO number for provisioning the reserved nodes.

I can own the architecture calls and the perf run. Tessa, let me know when to schedule the first technical sync.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
